in_sanskrit.name: नन्दन
in_sanskrit.meaning: नन्दते िति नाम निर्देशः । आनन्द्यता वा निर्मलता वा निर्विघ्नता वा विशेषणम् । स्वतन्त्रता वा सुखदः वा । विगत संतोषात् ।
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is content, free from sorrow, pure, free from obstacles, joyful, self-controlled and delights others.

in_marathi.name: Nandan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nandan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who brings delight, joy and prosperity, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nandana' which means delight, pleasure and joy.

in_bengali.name: Nandan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Delight, Joy
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nandan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who brings delight, joy and prosperity, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nandana' which means delight, pleasure and joy.
